capabilities: Orbit, pan and zoom a 3D force-directed graph of the whole vault
Inspect a selected note's links, folder, body preview and cluster growth chart
Create a new note linked back to the selected note from the inspector
Replay the vault's history as a timeline of notes appearing in creation order
Colour neighbourhoods by folder, tag, index status or recent activity
extras: Not yet on the Community Plugins store; must be installed manually from a release or built from source (Node 22 and npm). Desktop only, requires Obsidian 1.7.2+. Warns above 2,000 notes; rendering may be slower on older hardware.
intentEvidence: Notes matching Obsidian's Files and links → Excluded files setting are left out, as in the core graph.
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph view is flat and offers no 3D navigation, per-note inspection panel, or replay of how the vault grew over time.
summary: 3D force-directed graph view that renders the whole vault as a navigable galaxy with coloured link neighbourhoods, a note inspector and a creation timeline.
